description: Source upload step 3 of 3: the server re-reads the stored bytes and makes a PDF the draft source (the draft revision advances). For PDF_UPLOAD it verifies the PDF, hashes it and counts pages. For DOCX_LAYOUT it checks the Word package (no outside resources), converts it to PDF with its layout kept, then checks that PDF the same way; a converter outage or AGREEMENTS_NOT_CONFIGURED keeps the reservation so the same finalize can be retried, while a refused Word file (DOCUMENT_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED) ends it. pageCount and byteSize describe the resulting PDF. expectedSha256 is an optional cross-check of the uploaded file, PDF or Word (CHECKSUM_MISMATCH); finalizing before the PUT completes fails UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE. Receipt-backed: a replay returns the verified result. Requires agreements:write. Requires the agreements family flag and the agreements_native rollout; denials carry details.reason (AGENT_SURFACE_DISABLED, AGREEMENTS_DISABLED, TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED).

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key sent as the Idempotency-Key header. Same key + same payload replays the stored outcome (replayed: true); same key + a changed payload is a 409.
